acceptanceCriteria: A STALE_HOLDER attempt without a live lease is reaped by `reap` (or by the colliding claim per policy), with a test.
RESOURCE_COLLISION refusals name the colliding attemptId, ticketId, holderStatus and keys.
leaseExpiresAt is never null for an attempt holding reservations, or the null case is documented and reapable.
body: Observed 2026-10-19 (corvint-tasks, local build): attempt 00cf470f (V1-1194, generation 742, holder claude-orchestrator) was in phase CHECKING with holderStatus STALE_HOLDER and leaseExpiresAt null. Its 24 path reservations (incl. docs/specs/README.md, INDEX.json, REQUIREMENTS.tsv) made 16 unrelated closeout claims refuse RESOURCE_COLLISION until the operator found it in .git/taskman/reservations.json and released it by hand. Similarly, an attempt whose `complete` is refused GATE_FAILED keeps its reservation until released. Expected: a stale holder with no live lease is reapable (reap or claim reports it), and the RESOURCE_COLLISION refusal names the holding attempt, ticket and holderStatus so the operator does not need to read the reservation file.

title: Tasks: a STALE_HOLDER attempt stuck in CHECKING keeps its path reservation indefinitely and blocks every overlapping claim
